# argbuilder

> Zero-dependency Python CLI builders with a checkable correctness contract:
> definition bugs raise, user mistakes return values, and parsing is a pure
> function. The clap model, for Python 3.12+.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Tomperez98/argbuilder/blob/main/README.md): full behavior, examples, shell completion and clap mapping.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Tomperez98/argbuilder/blob/main/AGENTS.md): contract, getters, test pattern and invariants for coding agents.
- [examples/git.py](https://github.com/Tomperez98/argbuilder/blob/main/examples/git.py): a fuller CLI with subcommands.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Tomperez98/argbuilder/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): released changes.
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/argbuilder/): install.

## Core API

```python
from argbuilder import Arg, Command


def cli() -> Command:
    return (
        Command("greet")
        .arg(Arg("name").required(True))
        .arg(Arg("times").long("times").env("GREET_TIMES").value_parser(range(1, 6)).default_value("1"))
    )
```

- Builders are immutable: every method returns a new `Command` / `Arg`.
- `cli().debug_assert()` validates the whole definition; put it in a test.
- `cli().try_get_matches_from(argv, env={...})` returns `ArgMatches | Error`; pure.
- `cli().get_matches()` reads `sys.argv` / `os.environ`, prints errors and exits.
- `matches.get_required(id, T)` / `get_one(id, T)` / `get_many(id, T)` /
  `get_flag(id)` / `get_count(id)`.

## Parse test

```python
from argbuilder import ArgMatches

matches = cli().try_get_matches_from(["greet", "Ada"], env={"GREET_TIMES": "3"})
assert isinstance(matches, ArgMatches)
assert matches.get_required("times", int) == 3
```

## Errors

`ErrorKind` is a union of frozen dataclasses; match it instead of parsing
messages.

```python
match error.kind:
    case InvalidValue(argument=a, value=v): ...
    case UnknownArgument(argument=typed, suggestion=closest): ...
```

## Invariants

- Python 3.12+, no runtime dependencies.
- Definition mistakes raise `AssertionError`; user mistakes return `Error`.
- Keep the parser pure; process and terminal edges belong in `get_matches` /
  `Error.exit()`.
- Help, Markdown docs and completion all render from the same command tree.
